featured_reviews.name: Kshitij Chaubey
featured_reviews.review_text:
The Bunker is an amazing new restaurant and bar recently opened in Agashi, Virar. The concept and theme of this restaurant is based on Indian defence forces. As the name suggests it really feels like a bunker from inside with all the guns, designs, wallart, bunker sized window even the tissue holder is uniquely made which will all keep you mesmerized.

Now coming to the food, we tried "Dahi ke Shole" and I must tell you it was so dammn yummy. Koyla Chicken was another such dish which had unique taste made of their own made garam masala. Bunker special kebabs (stuffed with chicken) is also an amazing dish you can try. Chicken Gavran handi is also recommended by me, it has an authentic taste to it.

The service was top notch which was not expected from newly opened restaurant. The owners are very friendly and are working really hard to improve. Would surely love to visit again.

featured_reviews.name: Ajinkya Kamerkar (INVINCIBLE)
featured_reviews.review_text:
Good place to hang out with friends and family. Helping staff, good food, and good ambiance. As its name, it's a Bunker theme restaurant. You immediately get this vibe after entering. This place is huge for throwing a party for 25 - 30 people as well.
Air conditioning and washrooms can be improved. Or is it the part of the theme BUNKER🤔?

featured_reviews.name: Indie Cuisine
featured_reviews.review_text:
The Bunker is a fine dine restaurant in the Agashi area of Virar West. We went here for lunch on weekend. The place wasn't much crowded. They did proper sanitation and temperature check before handing us the menu. The ambience of this place caught my eye. They have a theme which pays tribute to Indian Army.

Now let's talk about what food we had :-
🍢 STARTERS
1. Chicken Koyla
2. Chicken Kalimiri Kebab
3. Chicken & Cheese Garlic Kebab
The Kebabs were presented very nicely and were amazing in taste. The first starter was okayish. The quantity felt a bit less looking at the price.
🍴MAINS
1. Murg Musallam
2. Butter Roti
3. Jeera Rice & Dal Tadka
The Murg Musallam was the best part of the day. The quantity was sufficient for 5 people and had big juicy pieces of chicken. The dal rice was a perfect way to end the meal.

featured_reviews.name: Shruti Vartak
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently ordered from Desilicious, and the overall experience was truly satisfying. The food was as delicious as the name Desilicious—fresh, flavorful, and perfectly spiced to reflect authentic desi taste. The service was prompt and courteous, making the entire process smooth and hassle-free. Cleanliness was well-maintained, with hygienic packaging and attention to detail. The pricing felt reasonable considering the generous portion sizes and quality of food, offering great value for money. The packaging was neat, secure, and ensured the food arrived hot and intact. Overall, it was a delightful experience, and I would definitely recommend Desilicious for a hearty and hygienic meal.

featured_reviews.review_text: We tried a variety of dishes like kebabs, butter garlic momos, chicken biryani, and more .   each one was absolutely delicious and top-notch in quality and taste!
